name: agent-inbox-unified-retrieval
title: Agent Inbox Unified Retrieval
description: Replace agent-inbox's current `all enabled tools stuffed into every turn's context` model with a Qdrant-backed semantic index over three surfaces: proto tools (from tool-authoring-standard), CLI commands (from cli-conversational-surface), and widgets (from widget-standard). Two retrieval tracks run simultaneously in auto-mode (the new default): (1) agent-led — every chat has a small set of always-available meta-tools (search_tools, search_commands, search_widgets) so the agent can pull surfaces on demand at negligible token cost; (2) passive — every user message is embedded and matched against the index, surfacing tools/commands as one-click-enable suggestions and auto-rendering high-confidence widgets inline. Manual enable/pin remains as an escape hatch. Benchmarks: recall@K on a routing eval set, tokens saved per turn, first-token latency budget <200ms. This is the UX payoff that makes phone-agent and non-technical users viable — `just talk and the system finds the right surface.`
